events.text:
T-284 is still blocked: the v2 videos can't go live until Adi gives an approve or redo verdict on each one in T-282. Everything that doesn't need those verdicts is staged and checked. Note F-f2cbf8e2 had already been acknowledged in an earlier run, so the ack changed nothing.

- **Web copies: done.** All 18 tools have an mp4, a poster and captions under `wt-review/<tool>/web/` in the walkthroughs checkout. They stay local and out of git.
- **walkthroughs.ts entries: done.** The `V2` table in `app/src/lib/walkthroughs.ts:373` has all 18 tools, and every one is in `V2_HELD_FOR_REVIEW`, so the 12 live v1 videos stay on their cards. Each entry has only a title and a length; the guide text was not changed, because the journey files are recording routes rather than guide text.
- **No google-signin: done.** It is not in the table.
- **Three checks: pass.** check-walkthroughs (12 ok), check-guides, and check-playbook-anchors (101 cards, 31 anchors).
- **Branch push: done.** Local `6b0a712` matches `origin/tantra-walkthroughs`. The only uncommitted file is the old `walkthrough-review.html`, which was left out on purpose because the new review index replaces it.
- **Status:** set to blocked, with needs_from_owner pointing at T-282. The Orchestrator asked for "waiting on T-282, not blocked", but this run had to finish as review, blocked, done or doing, and blocked is the only one that fits.
- **Per-tool swap, live centres and playbook on v2, no v1 left on an approved card:** waiting on T-282. As each verdict lands, the tool comes off the held lists, its web copy is published, the embed scripts and three checks run again, and READY goes in LOG.md for the Integrator to deploy.

Adi's review page: http://localhost:8883/wt-review/index.html?v=6b0a712
